# Jetware

> > Jetware provides customized, pre-configured operational environments for web applications and machine learning workloads, enabling rapid deployment across cloud platforms.

Jetware is an Italian cloud platform specializing in ready-to-use application stacks and constructors for web development, data science, and machine learning. The platform offers pre-built appliances for popular frameworks like WordPress, Node.js, and ML tools, along with customizable constructors for building tailored environments on AWS, Azure, and other cloud providers.

## Key Topics

- Jetware Platform
- Cloud Deployment
- LEMP Stack
- Docker Containers
- Machine Learning
- Web Applications
- Node.js
- Python Runtime
- WordPress
- Nginx Web Server
- SSL/HTTPS
- Jupyter Notebook
- TensorFlow & Keras
- AWS & Azure
- Installation Guides

## Appliances & Pre-Built Stacks

- [Appliances Catalog](https://it.jetware.io/appliances): Appliances catalog featuring ML stacks with TensorFlow and Keras
- [Jetware Appliances Documentation](https://it.jetware.io/appliances/jetware): Documentation for Jetware appliances including LEMP and LAMP stacks
- [WordPress on LEMP7](https://it.jetware.io/appliances/jetware/wordpress4_lemp7): WordPress installation guide on LEMP7 stack with MariaDB
- [Optimized LEMP7 Stack](https://it.jetware.io/appliances/jetware/lemp7_optimized): Optimized LEMP7 stack documentation with PHP7 and Nginx
- [Node.js 7 with Nginx](https://it.jetware.io/appliances/jetware/nodejs7_nginx): Installation guide for Node.js 7 with Nginx Docker appliance

## Machine Learning & Data Science

- [PyTorch with Jupyter Notebook](https://it.jetware.io/appliances/aise/pytorch03_python3_cpu_notebook): PyTorch with Jupyter Notebook appliance for machine learning
- [Theano Deep Learning with CUDA9](https://it.jetware.io/appliances/aise/theano1_python3_cuda9): Theano deep learning appliance with CUDA9 GPU computing
- [Machine Learning Education Constructor](https://it.jetware.io/constructors/machine_learning_education): ML education constructor with TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch stacks

## Stack Constructors

- [Stack Constructors Overview](https://it.jetware.io/constructors): Constructor overview for building custom software stacks
- [Node.js Stack Constructor](https://it.jetware.io/constructors/nodejs): Node.js stack constructor with Nginx and SSL/HTTPS support
- [Python Runtime Environment Constructor](https://it.jetware.io/constructors/python_runtime): Python runtime environment constructor for cloud deployment
- [In-Memory Databases Constructor](https://it.jetware.io/constructors/databases_memory): In-memory database constructor for memcached and Tarantool
